title: Novel BTK inhibitor reduces multiple sclerosis relapses
title_zh: 新型BTK抑制剂减少多发性硬化症复发
abstract: The novel Bruton’s tyrosine kinase inhibitor remibrutinib is superior to the established disease-modifying drug teriflunomide for reducing relapse rates in people with multiple sclerosis, according to recently released phase III trial data.
abstract_zh: 据最近发布的III期临床试验数据显示，新型布鲁顿酪氨酸激酶抑制剂雷米布鲁替尼在降低多发性硬化症患者复发率方面，优于已确立的疾病修饰药物替尔唑胺。
snippet: The novel Bruton’s tyrosine kinase inhibitor remibrutinib is superior to the established disease-modifying drug teriflunomide for reducing relapse rates in people with multiple sclerosis, according to recently released phase III trial data.
